questions.question: The Physics Nobel on Oct 6 went to a man who turned ice into a telescope. Where's the ice?
questions.fact: IceCube is a cubic kilometer of ice full of light sensors that catch neutrinos from deep space. Francis Halzen won for it.
questions.hint: Go as far south as the map goes.

questions.question: Wet Ones put ads all over New York this month. What do the hands in them look like?
questions.fact: The tagline: "Just for hands. No ifs, ands or butts." Wet Ones says the subway found the ads too risqué.
questions.hint: Think cheeky, in the literal sense.

terms.note: A brand of wet wipes for your hands.

questions.question: Max Verstappen won F1's Singapore Grand Prix on Oct 11. What was new?
options: His last race for Red Bull
questions.fact: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc came second and Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli came third.
questions.hint: Marina Bay had always slipped away from him.

terms.note: Formula 1, the top level of car racing.

questions.question: Greta Gerwig's Narnia trailer came out Oct 13. Who voices Aslan the lion?
questions.fact: In the trailer, Aslan only roars. The film opens in theaters Feb 12, 2027, then streams on Netflix on April 2.

terms.note: A world of talking animals from C.S. Lewis's books.

questions.question: The Chemistry Nobel on Oct 7 solved a puzzle about molecules that come in pairs. Which pairs?
questions.fact: Like your hands, many molecules come in left and right forms, and life uses only one. Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai showed how that can happen.
questions.hint: Hold up both hands and look at them.

terms.note: The tiny bits that make up a substance.

questions.question: Who became the first Chinese player to win the China Open on Oct 11?
questions.fact: She beat Mirra Andreeva 7-5, 6-4 after getting in on a wild card, ranked No. 54.

terms.note: A big yearly tennis event in Beijing.

questions.question: Apple showed off HomeView on Oct 13. What is it?
questions.fact: It has a 7-inch square screen and costs $299 in the US. It can tell up to six people in a home apart.
questions.hint: It lives on your kitchen counter or your wall.

questions.question: Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning opened the weekend of Oct 9. Which 2010 film did he also write?
questions.fact: It opened to $5.5 million. Mikey Madison, Jeremy Allen White and Jeremy Strong star.

questions.question: A Minnesota grower won the Half Moon Bay pumpkin weigh-off on Oct 12. How heavy was his pumpkin?
questions.fact: Travis Gienger won it. Second place weighed 2,273 lb and came from Rocklin, California.
questions.hint: It's over a ton but under a ton and a half.

terms.note: A contest to see who grew the heaviest one.

questions.question: The Jaguars beat the Eagles 19-17 on Oct 11 with a 57-yard kick as time ran out. In which city?
questions.fact: Cam Little made the kick at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
questions.hint: Think red buses and black cabs.

questions.question: Poet Anne Carson won the Literature Nobel on Oct 8. Where is she from?
questions.fact: The Swedish Academy praised her "bold and inventive" work, in "playful dialogue with the classical tradition."

questions.question: Alexander Zverev will finish 2026 as the men's tennis No. 1. He's the first man from which country to do it?
questions.fact: He won the French Open and the US Open this year. He's also the oldest man to finish No. 1 for the first time.

questions.question: Horror film Other Mommy was No. 1 at the box office Oct 9-11. Who stars?
questions.fact: It made $27.5 million in North America. Anne Hathaway's Verity came second.
questions.hint: She won an Oscar for The Eyes of Tammy Faye.

questions.question: As of Oct 11, who leads the F1 drivers' standings?
questions.fact: He has 340 points for Mercedes. His teammate George Russell is next with 238.
questions.hint: He drives for Mercedes, and he isn't George.
